import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Visualization ---

# Set a professional and clean style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7))

# Create a scatter plot to show the relationship between hour, amount, and type
# Using different markers and colors for each transaction type enhances clarity.
# The size of the points is increased for better visibility.
ax = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='hour_of_day',
    y='amount',
    hue='transaction_type',
    style='transaction_type',
    s=200,  # Increase marker size
    palette='viridis',
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.8
)

# Add annotations to each point for precise amount information
for i in range(df.shape[0]):
    plt.text(
        x=df['hour_of_day'][i] + 0.3,
        y=df['amount'][i],
        s=f"${df['amount'][i]:.2f}",
        fontdict=dict(color='black', size=9)
    )

# Improve plot aesthetics and readability
plt.title('Analysis of Individual Transactions by Hour and Amount', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(range(0, 25, 2))  # Set x-axis ticks for every 2 hours
plt.grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)

# Enhance the legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(handles=handles, labels=labels, title='Transaction Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=10)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels from being cut off
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.88, 1]) # Make space for the legend outside the plot area

# Save the generated visualization
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300)

plt.close()
